sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Electronic Retailing of Fast-Fashion Apparel and Footwear

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (Non-Resident Business Corporation Regime, Majuro/Ebeye)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – Common Law tradition with a U.S.-derived statutory corporate code modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law; unitary national system without sub-state tax distinctions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (1986, administered as amended 2003)
PACER Plus Regional Trade Agreement (signed 2017, in force 2020)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with the United States (2006)
Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation framework (AML/CFT standard-setting)
meta_jurisdiction_context.data_quality_note: Payload ISO-3166 alpha-3 value 'PNG' is erroneous; the correct alpha-3 code for the Republic of the Marshall Islands is 'MHL'.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (MIRC Title 24); Banking Act 1991, as amended (MIRC Title 22); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, as amended; Financial Intelligence Unit AML/CFT Regulations and Guidelines; Business Corporations (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations, as amended; APG recommendations and RMI National Risk Assessment standards.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Passport of each Shareholder, Director and Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the applicant's country of domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the issuing jurisdiction; Consular Legalization via RMI Consulate only where the issuing jurisdiction is not an Apostille Contracting Party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership Declaration Form under the Business Corporations (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized by the RMI licensed registered agent; Hague Apostille if execution is notarized outside the RMI in an Apostille state; otherwise Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference / Good Standing Letter for each named UBO or corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding financial institution of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the issuing jurisdiction followed by Hague Apostille; Consular Legalization required where the source state is not an Apostille party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency and Registered Agent Consent to Act
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Agent-stamped and notarized; Hague Apostille by RMI Competent Authority for foreign registry use; Consular Legalization where the receiving state is not an Apostille party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Registered Office Address in the Marshall Islands
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Agent's notarized confirmation; Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization per downstream receiving authority requirement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers and UBOs against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, US and EU/UK consolidated sanctions lists, and the RMI national sanctions list; mandatory PEP and family/close-associate identification with enhanced due diligence; negative media, adverse news, and source-of-funds/wealth checks under the RMI FIU risk-based approach for a standard low-risk e-commerce engagement.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Justice, Republic of the Marshall Islands – name clearance and reservation submitted through Licensed Registered Agents on the official RMI Corporate Registry online portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in English/Latin script; no Marshallese transliteration requirement; mandatory corporate suffix (Corporation, Incorporated, Limited, or their recognized abbreviations); the name must be distinguishable from all registered, reserved, and trade-marked names and must not be likely to mislead or confuse.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant obtains the Registrar's written refusal grounds, then files a written reconsideration request with the Registrar within 15 business days, attaching a revised proposed name or legal argument on distinguishability; a further refusal may be appealed to the Minister of Justice within 30 days; the licensed agent may request one 30-day extension of a valid reservation before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A physical registered office street address in the Marshall Islands (Majuro or Ebeye) maintained by a Licensed Registered Agent is mandatory; a pure virtual or shell address without an RMI street location is not permitted; no physical operational premises are required for a non-resident e-commerce business, but the registered agent and registered office must be continuously maintained.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 0.5%–2.0% annual likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection for a low-risk non-resident e-commerce entity with a compliant registered agent and no domestic trading nexus; probability escalates to 15%–25% upon sanctions flags, agent non-compliance, or returned-mail indicators.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation fee (per name)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under the Business Corporations Act 1990 (MIRC Title 24) registration rules

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee – standard authorized capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff in MIRC Title 24 based on authorized share capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register establishment and government filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations / RMI Financial Intelligence Unit consolidated levy
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: AML/CFT regulatory fee for central UBO data filing under the Business Corporations (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Registered Agent annual service fee (non-resident Business Corporation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard non-resident BC administration
Statutory registered office requirement; prevailing market tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML onboarding, CDD/KYC and UBO verification compliance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent / FIU reporting channel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for standard-risk profiles under the Banking Act 1991 and AML/CFT Act 2012

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and international sanctions screening data subscription (annual)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Third-party compliance data vendor engaged by the registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market subscription cost; no statutory tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of director, shareholder and UBO identity documents in domicile jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public in the country of domicile

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille and/or Consular Legalization of corporate and KYC documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Apostille Authority of the issuing state or RMI Consular Section
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official authentication and consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent / courier service provider

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (BCA), Sections 21 (Articles of Incorporation), 26 (Share Issuance), 28 (Registered Office), 38 (Board Authority), 50 (Officers); Registrar functions administered under the Associations Law.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (BCA Form 21); Certificate of Incorporation issued upon registration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement. Authorized capital: 10,000 Common Shares, no par value; consideration to be fixed by the Board of Directors under BCA Section 26.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation's issued share subscription schedule, comprising ten thousand (10,000) shares of Common Stock, without par value, is hereby ratified and accepted, and the Board of Directors is authorized to issue such shares for consideration determined by the Board pursuant to Section 26 of the Business Corporations Act; RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation shall be held at the office of its licensed registered agent within the Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the registered agent is authorized to receive process; RESOLVED, that the following officers are appointed: Chief Executive Officer, Treasurer, and Secretary, each to hold office until successors are duly appointed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the licensed registered agent's portal or by direct filing to the Registrar. The proposed name must end with 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or a permitted abbreviation, and must be distinguishable from existing registered entities. Pay the reservation fee and obtain the reservation certificate before filing the Articles.
required_dossiers: Corporate name search certificate (issued by Registrar)
Proof of government fee payment (bank wire/check receipt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for confusing similarity, file within 5 business days a revised reservation listing up to three alternate names; the Registrar will expedite review of alternates.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent / notary public recognized in the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a licensed RMI registered agent to draft the Articles of Incorporation under BCA Section 21, including corporate name, registered office (c/o registered agent), authorized shares, initial directors, and permitted purposes (including electronic retailing of apparel). Each subscriber must sign the Articles in the presence of a notary public, who shall attest to the signatures.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Registered Agent (signed by agent)
Consent to Act as Initial Director (signed by each director)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries a provision, submit a Certificate of Amendment setting out the corrected clause, or re-file the notarized Articles with the defect cured within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (filing accepted via registered agent's delegated authority)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the notarized Articles of Incorporation, director consents, and registered agent consent to the Registrar together with the $275 government filing fee (plus any applicable registered agent license fee). Upon review, the Registrar endorses the Articles and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, thereby creating the corporation.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation (signed and dated)
Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Consent to Act as Initial Director
Fee remittance advice (SWIFT/ACH/check) made payable to 'Registrar of Corporations, RMI'
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is returned for correction, cure the cited defect through a notarized correcting statement or re-submission; the Registrar will re-process within 3 business days without additional government fee for the first correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting — Bylaws, Share Issuance, and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Corporation (acting by unanimous written consent or convened meeting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organizational meeting (or execute unanimous written consent in lieu thereof) immediately after incorporation. Adopt the Bylaws, ratify the first board resolutions, approve the issuance of shares to subscribers, designate the registered office, and appoint the officers. The secretary shall attest the minutes or consent and file them with the corporate records.
required_dossiers: Unanimous written consent or organizational meeting minutes
Stock ledger and share certificates (share subscription schedule)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural defect in the organizational meeting may be cured by a subsequent ratifying board resolution under BCA Section 38, and corporate actions remain valid ab initio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations / licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation and a Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar. Ensure the registered agent files the annual report and corporate renewal declaration before the anniversary date, and maintain the registered office and agent records. Confirm that no additional business license is required for pure cross-border electronic retailing by a non-resident corporation.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
Certificate of Good Standing (issued by Registrar)
Annual Report / Renewal Declaration (filed by registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Good Standing contains errors, submit a rectification request with supporting corporate documents; the Registrar will issue a corrected certificate within 2 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Finance — Division of Business Licensing, Republic of the Marshall Islands (only triggers upon establishment of physical commercial premises within RMI)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business License / Retail Trading License (conditional and not required for an offshore non-resident corporation conducting pure electronic retailing of apparel)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA), constituted under the Environmental Protection Act 1984
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no manufacturing or industrial processing; a conditionally-registered facility applies only if a warehousing/logistics premises exceeding 200 m² is established in Majuro.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emission sources exist for electronic retailing; any sanitary discharge from an RMI warehouse must comply with RMI EPA Water Quality Regulations (BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L); packaging and returned-goods waste must be managed under the RMI Solid Waste Management Permit regime.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Majuro Fire and Rescue Authority for any warehousing or office premises; structural load and occupancy inspections per the RMI Building Code; occupational health and safety clearance under the RMI OSHA standards, applied where the corporation employs one (1) or more persons in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; corporate registration administered by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Association Registry), Majuro; filing and payments are effected through licensed registered agents recognized by the Registrar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Incorporate under the Business Corporations Act 1990 (BCA) through a licensed registered agent; the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation and a unique entity registration number. A Nonresident Corporation (BCA Section 105) deriving no income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands and maintaining no local office is not required to obtain a separate income-tax TIN or file RMI income tax returns. A voluntary taxpayer identification number may be obtained from the Revenue and Taxation Office solely for FATCA/CRS self-certification or local banking accommodation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — Nonresident Corporation under BCA Section 105; taxation is limited territorially to income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; foreign-source e-commerce income is outside the RMI income tax base and entity-level income tax does not apply.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: An eligible corporation may elect Nonresident Corporation status by filing a Statement or Articles Amendment with the Registrar of Corporations designating non-resident classification under BCA Section 105; the election is revocable by amendment converting the entity to a resident domestic corporation, which would subject it to the Income Tax Act 1999 on RMI-source income. The Republic of the Marshall Islands does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime and maintains no hybrid mismatch elective rules; its treaty network is negligible, so no hybrid mismatch treaty-based elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No_Value_Added_Tax_No_GST — the Republic of the Marshall Islands levies no national VAT, GST, or general sales tax; only customs import duty applies to physical importation of goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST regime exists, therefore no economic turnover threshold triggers indirect tax registration; importers must nonetheless register with RMI Customs for a customs/import duty account to process physical shipments.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing mandate exists: the Republic of the Marshall Islands has no real-time fiscal clearance system, no B2B/B2C electronic reporting obligation, and no digital stamping requirement. Cross-border fast-fashion e-commerce sales processed through Shopify Payments and Klarna remain outside any RMI fiscal invoicing or clearance net.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable as a VAT concept — because the Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT/GST, there is no 0% export VAT rate to claim and no refund mechanism. Substantive tax protection instead rests on Nonresident Corporation status: sales of fast-fashion apparel and footwear via online platforms to non-RMI customers constitute foreign-source income excluded from the RMI income tax base. Physical goods merely transiting RMI ports or using the RMI flag as a maritime registry do not create RMI-source income.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (RMI Customs export entry where goods physically leave RMI territory)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing carriage from the port or airport of loading
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/MT103 record evidencing offshore payment collection
Registered Agent Certificate attesting Nonresident Corporation status under BCA Section 105
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because the Republic of the Marshall Islands has no VAT/GST, there is no export zero-rating fraud exposure; however, material risks remain. Under the Income Tax Act 1999, if the Revenue and Taxation Office determines that the entity derived RMI-source income, the Nonresident Corporation exemption collapses; tax may be reassessed with interest and penalties of up to 100% of the tax deficiency. Under BCA Section 105, a false non-resident certification can result in revocation of registration, monetary penalties imposed by the Registrar, and reinstatement obligations. For physical shipments, customs duty evasion triggers seizure or forfeiture of goods and penalty assessments of up to three times the duty evaded.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Banking Commission (within the Ministry of Finance) — the RMI has no central bank; the US dollar is the sole legal tender and the de facto monetary anchor.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full dollarization means absolute convertibility for both current and capital account transactions. There are no foreign-exchange controls, no central bank approval requirements, and no separate exchange-rate regime. Profit remittances, dividends, and distributions to non-resident shareholders are freely payable in USD, subject only to corporate law solvency tests, tax clearance for licensed entities (if any), and anti-money laundering (AML) reporting thresholds. No capital account restrictions exist under RMI law.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender obligations or minimum conversion ratios exist. All receipts are retained in USD; the Banking Commission does not mandate repatriation timelines or conversion. Exporters must, however, maintain records supporting the underlying trade transaction for AML/CFT and tax audit purposes.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs and neobanks not licensed in RMI may provide onboarding convenience, but RMI-regulated banks generally do not treat them as qualified customer-facing financial institutions for treasury operations. Corporate bankers and auditors will expect the operating treasury account to be domiciled at an RMI-licensed or US federally insured bank. For fast-fashion e-commerce flows, a licensed EMI with a US partner bank may be used only for merchant settlement collection (e.g., Shopify Payments) and must be supplemented by a domestic clearing account for statutory disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: RMI banks apply a risk-based KYC regime aligned with the US Bank Secrecy Act pattern. Physical presence of directors is generally required for the initial corporate account opening of non-resident Business Corporations; remote opening is possible only through a notarized account-opening kit, apostilled corporate documents, and a live video interview with the bank's compliance officer. Senior management, at least one director, and the ultimate beneficial owner must be identifiable. Banks may waive physical visit only if the client maintains a pre-existing relationship with a recognized correspondent bank or a reputable introducer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with no local substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar, registered agent confirmation, board resolution authorizing account opening, detailed ownership chart up to ultimate beneficial owner, passport copies, proof of business address abroad, and a business plan showing genuine e-commerce operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border e-commerce payment flows (Shopify, Klarna)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant agreements, transaction volume forecasts, refund/chargeback policies, PCI-DSS attestation, source-of-funds evidence for seed capital, and a list of target settlement rails with corresponding compliance polices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or directors residing in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions screening report, residence/work permits, source-of-wealth documentation, professional reference letters from a licensed attorney or CPA, and enhanced due diligence questionnaire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected rapid movement of funds through the account (liquidity clearing)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cash-flow forecast, contract terms with suppliers, explanation of the payment cycle, and commitment to provide invoices and shipping documents for each disbursement above the bank's threshold.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections from shareholders or related parties must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from an account in the investor's jurisdiction, using standard payment purpose codes. Since RMI has no domestic foreign-exchange code, the bank relies on the remitting bank's purpose classification (e.g., OECD/IMF Balance of Payments code). Recommended narrative: 'Share capital contribution to RMI business corporation' or 'Director's loan — operating working capital'. The bank will require a board resolution, executed subscription agreement, and source-of-funds evidence. No RMI regulatory approval is required; funds become immediately available in USD.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for fast-fashion apparel purchases and logistics costs are typically executed via (a) SWIFT MT103 wire transfers for supplier invoices under USD 500,000; (b) Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) through a US correspondent or the bank's trade finance desk for larger bulk fabric or finished-goods shipments; and (c) card or local clearing networks for e-commerce platform fees. All outbound payments require supporting commercial invoices, bill of lading/air waybill, and the relevant stated purpose code. The bank will apply its own OFAC and AML transaction monitoring.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD is the functional currency; no local-currency FX hedging is needed.
Offshore USD/EUR or USD/CNY forward contracts through a US or non-RMI counterparty are permitted for hedging non-USD supplier costs where the bank maintains a global market access.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on Asian currencies may be used indirectly via a licensed international bank or fintech treasury provider, subject to the RMI bank's correspondent relationship.
Cross-currency swaps on major pairs (EUR/USD, JPY/USD) are permissible for balance-sheet hedging but require a documented operational FX risk policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Last day of the calendar month in which the anniversary date of incorporation falls (anniversary-month rule)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: US$200 late penalty if filed after the anniversary month; administrative revocation of the articles of incorporation by the Registrar if the report and fee remain unpaid for more than 3 months past the anniversary date; reinstatement requires payment of all accumulated arrears, penalties, and applicable reinstatement fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Annual Declaration and Distribution Fee (Income Tax Act, Section 184)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commissioner of Internal Revenue, RMI Taxation / Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable concurrently with the annual corporate report on the incorporation anniversary; due no later than the last day of the anniversary month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest and penalties assessed under the RMI Income Tax Act; sustained non-payment may impair the corporation's non-resident tax-exempt status, trigger suspension of good standing in Registrar records, and block issuance of tax-compliance and consular certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation to the Licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Resident Agent (registered office); Registry of Corporations only upon lawful request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the reporting anniversary established by the registered agent and, additionally, within 14 days of any change in beneficial ownership or any share transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or confirm accurate beneficial-ownership information exposes the company and the registered agent to fines imposed by the RMI Court on summary conviction; the Registrar may further treat the company as being without a compliant agent and proceed with administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for RMI Business Corporations: no revenue, asset, or size threshold, and no statutory requirement to appoint an independent auditor for non-resident business corporations. An audit becomes mandatory only by external contract (bank financing, payment-facilitator or acquirer agreements) or by shareholder resolution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutorily designated RMI Local GAAP. Accounting records must adequately reflect the financial position of the corporation under a recognized framework selected by the board, typically IFRS or US GAAP; voluntarily produced audited financial statements are conventionally prepared under IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The RMI operates a confidential beneficial-ownership regime: there is no public UBO register and no routine annual UBO filing to the Registrar. Each share transfer requires delivery of the counterparty's identity and beneficial-ownership particulars to the licensed registered agent, the register of members must be updated within 30 days of a transfer, and the agent must refresh the UBO confirmation annually and file/notify any change within 14 days. Share transfers require no prior governmental consent; approval is a matter for the board and the company's records only.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholder and board meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$800 – US$1,800 per year for a non-resident RMI Business Corporation including licensed registered office, resident agent representation, UBO register maintenance, and annual report coordination
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$3,500 – US$8,500 per year for a voluntarily procured or lender-required IFRS/US GAAP audit of a fast-fashion apparel e-commerce entity; such audit is not statutorily mandatory

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no gross receipts tax, and no excess profits tax on a non-resident Business Corporation
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective tax rate is 0%. Under the Business Corporations Act 1990, a non-resident domestic corporation is statutorily exempt from all Marshall Islands taxes and duties in consideration of the annual government franchise fee (standard minimum tier US$640 per annum for authorized capital up to US$50,000). No tax holiday application or preferential deduction regime is required or available.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Corporate Income Tax Return exists in the Marshall Islands for a non-resident Business Corporation. The only recurring statutory filing is the Annual Report (Registrar of Corporations reference form applicable to B.C.A. 1990 Section 87), submitted electronically through the licensed Registered Agent via the RMI Business Entities Registry portal (www.roc.com.mh). No tax return is filed with any revenue authority.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 31 December of each calendar year; the annual government fee is payable in advance for the forthcoming registration year; a newly incorporated BC must file its first Annual Report in the calendar year of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name shown on the Certificate of Incorporation, including any 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or 'Ltd.' suffix.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the English legal name exactly as registered; no transliteration or trading-name substitution is accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique entity file number assigned by the RMI Registrar of Corporations at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the 'MH' prefixed registration number from the incorporated certificate; verify against the agent's register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 3 - Registered Office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the BC's registered office located in the Republic, typically in Majuro or Ebeye.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident BC must maintain a registered office in the RMI through its licensed agent; a foreign address cannot be stated in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and RMI address of the licensed Registered Agent authorized by the Registrar to represent the corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Appoint a Class-1 licensed RMI corporate services agent; the company itself cannot act as its own agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and residential or business addresses of all individuals in office as directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors are permitted; the public registry reflects these entries, while beneficial ownership records are held in the agent's private KYC file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value (or no-par designation), class structure, and number of issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State exact share capital; authorized capital below US$50,000 qualifies for the minimum annual fee tier.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Actual principal operating address outside the Republic where the company conducts its business affairs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign addresses are expected for non-resident BCs; identify the e-commerce headquarters, fulfillment centers, and principal market jurisdiction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers escalating late fees imposed by the Registrar and loss of good standing. Failure to file for two consecutive years results in administrative dissolution or certificate revocation under B.C.A. Section 104. A struck-off or dissolved BC cannot lawfully contract, operate payment accounts, or appear in RMI courts; reinstatement requires payment of all cumulative government fees plus penalty surcharges.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a non-resident Business Corporation to any shareholder, whether resident or non-resident; dividends are repatriated free of all RMI taxation and may be declared in any freely convertible currency.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - the Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double tax agreement network with any major economy, and no treaty-relief or reduced-rate administrative procedure exists. The RMI issues no Tax Residency Certificate because no income tax is assessed. The relevant bilateral instruments are the US-RMI Tax Information Exchange Agreement (effective 2011) and the US-RMI FATCA Model 1 Intergovernmental Agreement (signed 16 March 2015), both of which govern information exchange rather than withholding relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory - the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on cross-border royalties or interest payments made by an RMI Business Corporation to non-residents. However, US-source royalty, licensing, and other fixed or determinable annual or periodic income paid to the RMI entity may be subject to US 30% withholding under IRC Section 1441 absent an applicable income tax treaty; no US-RMI income tax treaty exists, so IP holding arrangements must be supported by genuine substance and effectively connected income analysis.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - the Marshall Islands has no transfer pricing statute, no Local File or Master File obligation, and no country-by-country reporting regime; no local-currency threshold is codified. Practical benchmark: maintain contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation where related-party cross-border transactions exceed US$1,000,000 equivalent per annum to withstand foreign revenue authority audits.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations; no domestic substance filing, economic substance test, or related compliance obligation applies to non-resident Business Corporations. The RMI was placed on the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions (Annex I) on 14 February 2023 on tax-transparency grounds, activating EU defensive measures such as enhanced monitoring, DAC6 disclosure scrutiny, and potential withholding or CFC attribution by EU member states. Foreign tax authorities will apply their own substance doctrines, US Subpart F and PFIC rules, UK CFC rules, and EU ATAD anti-abuse measures to attribute fast-fashion e-commerce profits to the ultimate beneficial owner's residence jurisdiction unless real management, employees, procurement, IT infrastructure, and IP development are genuinely located in the RMI.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the non-resident RMI Business Corporation as a pass-through shell for fast-fashion e-commerce receipts to conceal taxable income from the ultimate beneficial owner's country of tax residence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No RMI domestic tax penalty applies because no RMI income tax is levied; however, the foreign residence jurisdiction will impose fraud penalties, e.g., under the US Internal Revenue Code a 75% civil fraud penalty on the underpaid tax plus interest, and criminal tax evasion penalties of up to US$100,000 fine (individual) or US$500,000 (corporation) and imprisonment of up to 5 years. Enforcement is facilitated by the US-RMI Tax Information Exchange Agreement and the FATCA automatic exchange channel.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee and de facto directors who knowingly execute an evasion scheme face personal civil restitution orders, foreign asset freezes, travel bans under criminal procedure, extradition under the US-RMI extradition treaty (in force), and imprisonment in the residence jurisdiction; the UBO additionally faces money-laundering charges where proceeds are layered through RMI bank accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a zero-substance RMI entity with no physical office, nominee directors, and no operational records while the UBO retains unfettered control of Shopify Payments, Klarna BNPL settlement accounts, and third-party payment gateways.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under RMI law, the Registrar of Corporations may administratively dissolve the BC and revoke its certificate for default in annual filing. Foreign tax authorities may apply sham transaction and economic substance doctrines to disregard the entity and reattribute all e-commerce income to the UBO with back taxes, interest, and penalties; EU member states may impose 25% defensive withholding on payments to the entity as an EU-listed jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: RMI courts will pierce the corporate veil where the company is demonstrated to be the alter ego of a dominant shareholder; directors face disqualification orders, civil restitution of diverted funds, and personal liability for contracts entered on behalf of a dissolved company; travel bans and arrest warrants may issue in cross-border insolvency or fraudulent trading proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a complete KYC file on the ultimate beneficial owner, processing high-volume BNPL and card payments without an AML/CFT compliance program, or transacting with OFAC or UN-listed sanctioned counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Criminal Code 2019 and the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2019, money laundering is a serious criminal offence carrying substantial custodial sentences and criminal fines; regulatory action may also suspend or revoke the licensed agent's authorization, barring the entity from further operations in the RMI; US OFAC violations separately expose the payment processors and any US nexus to civil penalties per violation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers with knowledge or willful blindness can be prosecuted personally in the RMI and extradited to partner jurisdictions; personal assets are subject to freezing and forfeiture orders; directors may be banned from serving as officers of any RMI entity and face imprisonment in the jurisdiction where the predicate offence occurred.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Sourcing fast-fashion inventory and digital marketing services from related entities in Hong Kong or mainland China, and licensing the brand IP to the RMI BC, without intercompany agreements, transfer pricing studies, or demonstrable RMI substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No RMI penalty arises domestically; exposure sits in counterparty jurisdictions: Chinese and Hong Kong tax authorities may reassess outbound service and royalty payments, apply 5-15% withholding on royalties, and levy penalties of up to 5 times the underpaid tax; the US IRS may reallocate income under IRC Section 482 with a 40% valuation misstatement penalty and impose Subpart F inclusions on the RMI entity as a controlled foreign corporation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing intercompany agreements without commercial substance can be joined in foreign tax and insolvency proceedings; backdating or falsifying agreements triggers criminal fraud exposure with custodial sentences in the counterparty jurisdiction and professional disqualification.
